title.zh: Crypto industry turns to US regulators after CLARITY setback
title.en: Crypto industry turns to US regulators after CLARITY setback

current_state.zh: The CLARITY Act failed a Senate cloture vote 49-50, prompting crypto industry leaders to look to the SEC and CFTC for regulatory clarity via rulemaking instead of legislation.
